records.name: Shrine & Parish of Our Lady of Willesden
records.notes: Current 2026 parish newsletter explicitly says Sunday 5:30pm Latin Mass — 1962 Missal. A 25/07/2021 parish statement says Cardinal Vincent responded positively to the parish priest's application to continue celebrating the 1962 Missal. No public Apostolic-See dispensation document was located in this tranche.

records.name: Corpus Christi Shrine, Covent Garden
records.notes: Current parish page explicitly labels these as Extraordinary Form / Missal of 1962 / Tridentine Mass. The church is also the Westminster Diocesan Shrine of the Blessed Sacrament. Schedule evidence is current; a separate public authorization instrument was not located.

records.name: SS Gregory & Augustine
records.notes: Current parish page states that the Traditional Latin Mass is celebrated according to the Roman Missal of 1962 and gives the recurring schedule. Page identifies the parish as part of the Archdiocese of Birmingham.

records.name: St Patrick's Mission
records.notes: The Diocese states that St Patrick's is a Mission, designated by the Bishop as the home of the Latin Mass in the Diocese, with Mass at 1pm every Sunday. A current parish source confirms that the 1962-Missal EF community was moved there by the Bishop in 2021.

records.name: St Brigid's, Toryglen
records.notes: Archdiocese states that authorities in Rome gave permission for the 1962 Latin Mass at St Brigid's despite parish-church restriction, and identifies St Brigid's as the sole venue in the archdiocese, Sundays 9:30am.

records.name: St Joseph's Chapel, Lawside
records.notes: Bishop Stephen directly authorized the diocesan 1962-Missal community's then-current arrangements in 2021. The community's current official site states that from 21/06/2026 Sunday Mass is 1pm at St Joseph's Chapel Lawside. A public diocesan instrument authorizing the 2026 venue change was not located, so current-venue authorization remains NOT_PUBLICLY_ESTABLISHED.

records.name: St Mary's, Ballyhea
records.notes: Current Diocese of Cloyne parish page states that Mass will be celebrated in Latin according to the Missal of St Pope John XXIII (1962), as per Diocesan Directory. The page lists general parish Mass times but does not identify which listed slot is the 1962 Mass.

records.name: Saint-Eugène–Sainte-Cécile
records.notes: Current Diocese of Paris index lists recurring 1962 Masses and the parish publishes a full current 1962 schedule. The Archbishop's 08/09/2021 instruction expressly designated this church and required written mission for priests. No public post-2023 Apostolic-See dispensation instrument was located.

records.name: Saint-Roch
records.notes: Current Diocese of Paris 1962 index lists the Sunday schedule. The 2021 archiepiscopal instruction designated Saint-Roch as one of the five Paris churches for the 1962 Missal.

records.name: Sainte-Odile
records.notes: Current Diocese of Paris pages show 1962 celebrations and current address; 2021 archiepiscopal instruction expressly designated Sainte-Odile.

records.name: Sainte-Jeanne-de-Chantal
records.notes: Current parish page explicitly states Sunday noon Mass according to the 1962 Missal. The 2021 archiepiscopal instruction expressly designated the parish.

records.name: Notre-Dame des Armées
records.notes: Current 2026 official site identifies Notre-Dame des Armées as a personal parish of the Diocese of Versailles in the extraordinary form and publishes the current schedule. No public post-2023 Apostolic-See dispensation instrument was located in this tranche.

records.name: Église Notre-Dame des Victoires
records.notes: Current Diocese of Angers parish site explicitly labels the recurring celebrations 'Missel St Jean XXIII'. Official parish heritage identifies the church entrance from Place Imbach; the presbytery is at 3 rue de l'Aubrière.

records.name: Église Notre-Dame
records.notes: Current parish pages explicitly state the Sunday 10:30 and weekday celebrations use the 1962 Latin Missal. A separate current public authorization instrument was not located, so schedule and authorization remain distinct.

records.name: Église Saint-Mathieu
records.notes: Current parish pages explicitly list Sunday 10:30 according to the 1962 Missal. The parish contact page provides the Saint-Mathieu presbytery address; a separate public authorization decree was not located.

records.name: Église Saint-Patern
records.notes: Current parish site explicitly publishes the extraordinary-form schedule and states that the parish celebrates both the current Roman rite and the 1962 Missal. The address given is the parish/presbytery contact adjacent to Saint-Patern.

records.name: Saint-Jean-Baptiste
records.address: Place de la Mairie, 92350 Le Plessis-Robinson
records.notes: Current parish homepage explicitly states Sunday 10:00 Mass for the faithful attached to celebration according to the 1962 Missal. Canonical parish-church status and any reserved dispensation evidence were not established from the current public source.

records.name: Église Notre-Dame
records.notes: Current parish liturgy page explicitly says Sunday 10:00 at Notre-Dame in Gregorian Latin according to the 1962 Missal. Current parish church directory supplies the venue address; a separate public authorization instrument was not located.

records.name: Chapel of the Little Flower
records.notes: Current diocesan chapel page gives the live schedule. Bishop Martin's 2025 implementation statement explicitly designated this non-parish chapel for Sunday and holy-day celebrations using the Roman Missal of 1962.

records.jurisdiction: Diocese of Tulsa and Eastern Oklahoma
records.name: Saints Peter and Paul Parish and Diocesan Shrine of Saint Toribio Romo
records.notes: Latest public diocesan directory located and checked in this tranche explicitly lists Sunday 10:30 '1962 RM/EF (Latin)'. A separate current public authorization instrument was not located.

records.name: Our Lady of the Most Holy Rosary
records.notes: Current October 2026 parish calendar explicitly labels the Sunday 7:00 Low Mass and 11:00 sung Mass as the 1962 Missal. The Archdiocese's current Traditional Latin Mass page lists Holy Rosary as a TLM parish and identifies its current diocesan pastor.

records.name: Sacred Heart of Mary Parish
records.notes: Current parish page explicitly says the Traditional Latin Mass according to the 1962 Missal is celebrated Sunday 12:30 and Tuesday noon. The 2021 archdiocesan decree publicly authorized continued 1962 use at this parish church. No later public Apostolic-See dispensation document was located.

records.name: St. John XXIII Catholic Church
records.notes: Current parish page says the Traditional Latin Mass is celebrated every Sunday at 11:30. The Denver decree identifies this community specifically as Mass according to the 1962 Roman Missal and authorizes continued use at the parish church.

records.name: Sacred Heart of Jesus TLM at Sacred Heart Academy
records.notes: Current Arlington Latin Mass Society schedule lists Sunday 8:30 at Sacred Heart Academy. The diocesan implementation policy explicitly designates Sacred Heart Academy as the permitted off-site location; current diocesan worship pages continue to direct the faithful to current 1962-Missal parish provision.

records.name: St. Patrick TLM in the Historic Church
records.notes: Current community schedule lists the historic church with recurring Sunday and weekday TLMs. The diocesan implementation policy expressly designates the former church building as the permitted location.

records.name: St. John the Apostle TLM in the Historic Chapel
records.notes: Current community schedule lists Sunday 10:30 in the historic chapel. The diocesan implementation policy expressly designates this alternate location.

records.name: St. Rita of Cascia
records.notes: Current 2026 community schedule shows recurring TLMs. The 2022 diocesan policy authorized parish-church use and a later public renewal was reported through summer 2026; a current post-summer-2026 Holy-See renewal instrument was not located. Current venue fact is promoted; current authorization evidence remains conservative.

records.name: St. John the Beloved
records.notes: Current 2026 community schedule shows recurring TLMs. The 2022 diocesan policy authorized parish-church use; public evidence for renewal beyond the reported summer-2026 extension was not located.

records.name: St. Anthony of Padua Mission
records.notes: Current 2026 community schedule shows recurring TLMs at the mission. The 2022 diocesan policy authorized parish/mission church use; public evidence for renewal beyond the reported summer-2026 extension was not located.

records.name: Church of the Holy Trinity
records.notes: Current parish homepage explicitly says the 1pm Tridentine Latin Mass is according to the 1962 Roman Missal.

records.name: Mary Immaculate of Lourdes
records.notes: Current parish site explicitly distinguishes the 1970 and 1962 Missals and says the 1962 form is celebrated with the blessing of the Archbishop; no separate current decree was located.

records.name: Church of the Holy Name of Jesus
records.notes: Current parish page states the Tridentine Mass uses the liturgical books of 1962 with local-bishop permission; the current diocesan parish finder continues to list Extraordinary Form celebrations.

records.name: St. Joseph Parish
records.notes: Current parish homepage explicitly labels each traditional Mass as 1962 Missal.

records.name: Transfiguration of Our Lord Parish
records.notes: Current parish states Sunday and daily Masses are according to the 1962 Roman Missal. Bishop Lucia's July 2026 statement identifies Transfiguration as the diocesan TLM parish.

records.name: Our Lady of Good Counsel
records.notes: Current parish page lists the Ancient Rite Latin Mass every Sunday at 8am. Bishop Lucia's July 2026 statement directs faithful to this parish 'by indult' in the 1962-Missal context.

records.name: Blessed Sacrament Church, Pauoa
records.notes: Current diocesan parish listing gives Latin Extraordinary Form at Sunday 10am and first Saturday 9am; the TLM community page explicitly says 1962 Roman Missal. Bishop Silva's instruction is explicitly for the 1962 Missal.

records.name: Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of Peace
records.notes: Current Blessed Sacrament TLM community schedule gives a First Friday 7pm traditional Mass at the Cathedral; Bishop Silva's 1962-Missal instruction supplies the diocesan authorization context.

records.name: Franciscan Monastery of the Holy Land in America
records.notes: Current TLM community schedule lists Sunday 9am. Archdiocese of Washington decree explicitly designates the Franciscan Monastery as a Sunday location for the 1962 Roman Missal.

records.name: Mission Church of St. Dominic
records.notes: Current parish page lists Sunday 3pm Extraordinary Form. Archdiocesan decree explicitly designates St Dominic as a Sunday 1962-Missal location.

records.name: Prince of Peace Catholic Church
records.notes: Current parish schedule lists recurring Latin Masses. The Diocese of Charleston policy explicitly permits Mass according to the Missal of 1962 at Prince of Peace.

records.name: Our Lady of the Lake Catholic Church
records.notes: Current parish page lists Sunday 1pm Latin Mass; current 2026 parish materials identify it as Traditional Latin/EF. The diocesan policy explicitly identifies Our Lady of the Lake as a permitted 1962-Missal parish.

records.name: Stella Maris Catholic Church
records.notes: Current parish schedule lists Sunday and First-Friday Latin Masses; the current diocesan policy explicitly names Stella Maris among parishes permitted to celebrate the 1962 Missal.

records.name: Sacred Heart Church
records.notes: Current Carolina traditional-liturgy schedule lists Sunday noon at Sacred Heart; the diocesan policy separately permits the 1962 Missal there. Schedule and authorization remain separate claims.

records.name: St. Mary of the Assumption
records.notes: Current parish page lists Sunday 2pm Traditional Latin Mass. Bishop Lucia's July 2026 statement identifies St. Mary Binghamton as an indult location in the current 1962-Missal context.

records.name: Shrine & Parish Church of the Holy Innocents
records.notes: Current parish schedule gives recurring Tridentine Masses; the parish's own current About page explicitly identifies its Extraordinary Form as the 1962 edition.
